facts.raw_span: A 74-year-old man
history of multiple squamous cell carcinomas
treated with Mohs micrographic surgery
tender, enlarging scalp lesion of 6 months' duration
5-mm bright pink, dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels
no purulent discharge or overlying skin changes
Hematoxylin-eosin staining demonstrated concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells
cells were hyperchromatic and variable in nuclear size, with scattered mitoses and necrosis
Smooth muscle actin (SMA) was diffusely positive in the tumor cells
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
Negative staining for: smooth muscle myosin, h-caldesmon, calponin, desmin, Kaposi sarcoma–associated herpesvirus, SOX10, human melanoma black, S-100, and STAT6
